rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=24, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=4, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-17 (one knob vs iter-16 best). NUMBERS: soft_thresh axis CLOSED -> 0.0 optimal (iter-16 hr0.03753, RMSE0.005019); n_bands=24 locked; n_outer=1 locked. FAILURE MODE: motion_range (the +-pixel span of the symmetric motion search that interpolates the residual sinogram to 2x angles) was only swept at the BROKEN n_outer=0 point; never at this good operating point. base 8. On DENSE 128-view breast data adjacent views are close so the true midpoint-view detector shift is SMALL; a wide +-8 search can pick spurious far L1 matches that inject noise into the densified residual. ONE KNOB: wu_motion_range 8 -> 4 (narrower; n_bands/thresh/n_outer locked). HYPOTHESIS: if a narrower motion search restricts matches to the physically-plausible small shifts, the densified residual is cleaner and RMSE drops -> hr above 0.03753; if it clips genuine larger shifts (hr down), range>=8 is confirmed. Budget: narrower search is CHEAPER, ~seconds.
